generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: Network error. Please check your connection.
unauthorized: You are not authorized to perform this action.
notFound: The requested resource was not found.
serverError: Server error. Please try again later.
timeout: Request timed out. Please try again.
validation: Please check the form for errors.

form.tooLong: Must be no more than {{max}} characters

whatsappDisconnected.title: WhatsApp isn't connected
whatsappDisconnected.body: Nothing can be sent or received until you connect your WhatsApp number. Connect it, then try again.

notOnWhatsapp.title: This number isn't on WhatsApp
notOnWhatsapp.body: {{phone}} doesn't have an active WhatsApp account, so the message couldn't be delivered. Double-check the number and country code.
notOnWhatsapp.bodyNoPhone: This number doesn't have an active WhatsApp account, so the message couldn't be delivered. Double-check the number and country code.

invalidPhone.title: That phone number looks off
invalidPhone.body: The number doesn't match the chosen country. Pick the right country or write the number with its code, e.g. +9665XXXXXXXX.

emptyMessage.title: Nothing to send
emptyMessage.body: Add a message or an attachment before sending.

warmupLimit.title: Daily warm-up limit reached
warmupLimit.body: New numbers are throttled while they warm up to protect them from bans. You've sent {{sent}} of {{limit}} today — the limit resets at midnight.
warmupLimit.bodyGeneric: New numbers are throttled while they warm up to protect them from bans. The daily limit resets at midnight.

tooManyRecipients.title: Too many recipients for one send
tooManyRecipients.body: You can send to up to {{max}} contacts at once from here. For a bigger audience, use a Broadcast instead.
tooManyRecipients.bodyGeneric: You've picked more recipients than a single send allows. For a bigger audience, use a Broadcast instead.

rateLimited.title: Sending a little too fast
rateLimited.body: To stay safe from bans, messages are paced out automatically. Wait a moment, then try again.

mediaFailed.title: The attachment couldn't be sent
mediaFailed.body: We couldn't upload or fetch the file. Re-attach it and try again.

auth.title: Your session expired
auth.body: For your security you've been signed out. Please sign in again to continue.

network.title: Can't reach the server
network.body: We couldn't connect to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: The action didn't go through. Please try again — if it keeps happening, contact support.

whatsappBlocked.title: WhatsApp isn't sending right now
whatsappBlocked.body: Your WhatsApp connection needs attention before messages can go out. A manager can see the reason and fix it in Settings → WhatsApp.

needsTemplate.title: This chat needs a template
needsTemplate.body: This customer hasn't messaged you in the last 24 hours, so WhatsApp only allows a pre-approved template message. Send a template to start the conversation.

templateProblem.title: This template can't be sent
templateProblem.body: It may be paused, not approved yet, or missing information. Pick another template or check this one on the Templates page.

accountRestricted.title: WhatsApp has limited this account
accountRestricted.body: Meta has temporarily restricted sending from your WhatsApp number. A manager can see the details in WhatsApp Manager.

whatsappBusy.title: WhatsApp is having a temporary problem
whatsappBusy.body: This usually clears up within a minute. Please try again shortly.

notDelivered.title: WhatsApp didn't deliver this message
notDelivered.body: WhatsApp limits how many promotional messages one person receives. Try again later or send something more personal.

managerOnly.title: Only a manager can do this
managerOnly.body: Your account doesn't have permission for this action. Ask a manager if it needs to be done.

notSetUp.title: WhatsApp isn't connected yet
notSetUp.body: A manager needs to connect your company's WhatsApp number in Settings → WhatsApp first.

plain.whatsappBlocked: WhatsApp isn't sending right now. A manager can see why in Settings → WhatsApp.
plain.needsTemplate: This customer hasn't messaged you in the last 24 hours, so WhatsApp only allows a pre-approved template. Send a template to start the conversation.
plain.notOnWhatsapp: This number doesn't have WhatsApp, so the message couldn't be delivered.
plain.notDelivered: WhatsApp didn't deliver this promotional message. Try again later.
plain.rateLimited: Sending a little too fast — messages will continue in a moment.
plain.templateProblem: This template can't be sent right now. Try another template.
plain.accountRestricted: WhatsApp has temporarily limited this account. A manager can check WhatsApp Manager.
plain.whatsappBusy: WhatsApp is having a temporary problem. Please try again in a minute.
plain.whatsappRejected: WhatsApp couldn't accept this message. Please try again — if it keeps happening, let a manager know.
plain.managerOnly: Only a manager can do this.
plain.notSetUp: WhatsApp isn't connected yet. A manager can connect it in Settings → WhatsApp.
plain.serverNotReady: This feature isn't ready on the server yet. Please contact support.
plain.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
plain.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
plain.fileTooLarge: This {{kind}} is {{size}} MB. WhatsApp allows up to {{limit}} MB — please choose a smaller file.
plain.fileTooLargeGeneric: This file is too large to send on WhatsApp. Please choose a smaller one.
plain.invalidPhone: This phone number is not valid for the chosen country. Check the digits or the country.

template.whatsappLinkButton: WhatsApp doesn't allow a button that opens a WhatsApp link (a group link or wa.me). Remove that button, put the link in the message text, then submit for review.
template.nameTaken: Another template on WhatsApp already has this name and language. Rename the template or use the Duplicate button (two-squares icon) to create a new one, then submit it.
template.notEditable: WhatsApp doesn't allow editing this template. Use the Duplicate button (two-squares icon) on the Templates page to create a new one with your changes and submit it.
template.editLimit: You've reached WhatsApp's edit limit for this template (about once every 24 hours). Wait a day, or use the Duplicate button (two-squares icon) to create a new template.
template.variableAtEdge: The message can't start or end with a blank like {{example}}. Add a word before or after it, e.g. "Hi {{example}}".
template.tooManyVariables: Too many blanks for the length of the message. Add more text or use fewer blanks.
template.wrongCategory: WhatsApp rejected the template because its content doesn't fit the chosen category. If it promotes an offer, choose Marketing and submit again.
template.invalidFormat: WhatsApp rejected the template because of its formatting. Check blanks are written like {{example}} and the text has no errors, then submit again.
template.policy: WhatsApp rejected the template for breaking its policies. Reword it in a clear, non-exaggerated way, or ask a manager.
template.noReason: WhatsApp rejected the template without giving a reason. Review the wording, links and buttons, then submit again.
template.headerMedia: The attachment (image or file) couldn't be read. Remove it, upload it again, then submit.
template.buttonUrl: The website button link is invalid. Enter the full address starting with https://
template.buttonPhone: The call button number is invalid. Use international format, like +966500000000.
template.tooManyButtons: Too many buttons. WhatsApp allows at most one call button and two website buttons.
template.buttonTextLong: A button label is too long. Keep it to 25 characters or fewer.
template.footerLong: The footer is too long. Keep it to 60 characters or fewer.
template.footerVariable: The footer can't contain blanks like {{example}}. Remove them from the footer.
template.bodyRequired: Write the message text before submitting for review.
template.appIdRequired: Templates with an image or file need the Meta App ID. Ask a manager to add it in Settings → WhatsApp, or remove the attachment.
template.wabaRequired: The WhatsApp connection is incomplete. Ask a manager to add the WhatsApp Business Account ID in Settings → WhatsApp.
